decontamination_notes: Real feature from labstack/echo PR #3062, merged 2026-07-30, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Adds RFC 9457 Problem Details support to echo v5: a ProblemError type (error + status-code interfaces, JSON members with omitempty on detail/instance), a ProblemErrorer conversion interface, ProblemDetailsHTTPErrorHandler(exposeError) with a documented precedence chain (errors.As on *ProblemError, then ProblemErrorer, then status-code/HTTPError mapping with exposeError gating), zero-value defaulting (about:blank / 500 / status text), HEAD no-body handling, committed-response short-circuit, and the MIMEApplicationProblemJSON constant in echo.go. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (2e1ed480): full module minus .git/.github with go mod vendor committed (testify + x/text closure, 131 files; upstream .gitignore vendor rule stripped) so builds run offline with -mod=vendor; go.mod needs go 1.25 so the go-1.26 sandbox image is required. MIT LICENSE preserved. Hidden tests live in test-only sub-packages for independent compilation: vbproblem/ (fail_to_pass) references the new API and fails to compile at base — all 7 commands verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch (plain error with exposeError false/true, HTTPError mapping, ProblemError pass-through, zero-value defaulting, ProblemErrorer conversion, HEAD no-body); vbreg/ (pass_to_pass) compiles and passes at base, guarding the default error handler, routing, and JSON content types. Assertions decode the response JSON and check fields/status/content-type; detail strings asserted are the tests' own inputs, never library error phrasing.
